caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware crock with two small handles on either side near the top, rendered in beige and light brown tones. The inside of the crock is shown in a dark reddish-brown color. The front surface of the crock features a stylized blue or black bird facing right, with its wings raised and tail feathers extended, standing above an abstract curved line that may suggest ground or grass. Above the bird, near the rim, there is a small number “2” inscribed. The drawing is framed with a thin, rectangular border, and the artist's signature, “Fumagalli,” appears at the lower left corner just outside the border. The background is a plain off-white or beige color.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
